entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return these useless shoes right now. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Alex Thompson, order number is 772-V-901. Don't waste my time, just process the return.
Okay, I have your account pulled up, Alex. Thank you for your loyalty, I see you're a VIP member with us. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

What's the issue? They're terrible! They gave me massive blisters on my heels after just two classes. And the cleats feel misaligned; I can barely clip in and out of the pedals. I want a refund, not an interrogation. This is the worst product I've ever bought from you.
I am so sorry to hear about the blisters and the trouble with the cleats. That is definitely not the experience we want for our members. Let me just review the return policy for this item.
You'd better. If I don't get my money back, I'm lighting you up on every social media platform and review site I can find. I expect better service from VeloFit.

I understand your frustration completely. Okay, I've checked the policy. I see the delivery was 36 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you immediately.
About time! So what's the next step? Send me the label.

Of course. I am emailing the pre-paid return label to you right now. And for the trouble you've gone through, especially as a valued VIP member, I've also added a $50 credit to your account for a future purchase. I sincerely apologize again for the issue.
Okay. A credit is acceptable. I'll watch for that email. Thank you.
It has just been sent. You should see it within a few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
